L0: # Search prices
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L8: > Nested parameters, fields, and event types on API reference pages are collapsed by default. Use the provided `?query=<name>` links to show the full definitions. Request the page with an empty `?query=` to expand every entry at once.
L9: Search for prices you’ve previously created using Stripe’s [Search Query Language](https://docs.stripe.com/search.md#search-query-language). Don’t use search in read-after-write flows where strict consistency is necessary. Under normal operating conditions, data is searchable in less than a minute. Occasionally, propagation of new or updated data can be up to an hour behind during outages. Search functionality is not available to merchants in India.
L10: ## Request
L11: 
L12: ```curl
L13: curl -G https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices/search \
L14:   -u "<<YOUR_SECRET_KEY>>" \
L15:   --data-urlencode "query=active:'true' AND metadata['order_id']:'6735'"
L16: ```
L17: ### Response
L18: ```json
L19: {
L20:   "object": "search_result",
L21:   "url": "/v1/prices/search",
L22:   "has_more": false,
L23:   "data": [
L24:     {
L25:       "id": "price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh",
L26:       "object": "price",
L27:       "active": true,
L28:       "billing_scheme": "per_unit",
L29:       "created": 1679431181,
L30:       "currency": "usd",
L31:       "custom_unit_amount": null,
L32:       "livemode": false,
L33:       "lookup_key": null,
L34:       "metadata": {
L35:         "order_id": "6735"
L36:       },
L37:       "nickname": null,
L38:       "product": "prod_NZKdYqrwEYx6iK",
L39:       "recurring": {
L40:         "interval": "month",
L41:         "interval_count": 1,
L42:         "trial_period_days": null,
L43:         "usage_type": "licensed"
L44:       },
L45:       "tax_behavior": "unspecified",
L46:       "tiers_mode": null,
L47:       "transform_quantity": null,
L48:       "type": "recurring",
L49:       "unit_amount": 1000,
L50:       "unit_amount_decimal": "1000"
L51:     }
L52:   ]
L53: }
L54: ```
L55: ## Returns
L56: 
L57: A dictionary with a `data` property that contains an array of up to `limit` prices. If no objects match the query, the resulting array will be empty. See the related guide on [expanding properties in lists](https://docs.stripe.com/expand.md#lists).
L58: ## Parameters
L59: 
L60: - `query` (string, required)
L61:   The search query string. See [search query language](https://docs.stripe.com/search.md#search-query-language) and the list of supported [query fields for prices](https://docs.stripe.com/search.md#query-fields-for-prices).
L62: 
L63: - `limit` (integer, optional)
L64:   A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
L65: - `page` (string, optional)
L66:   A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don’t include this parameter on the first call. Use the next_page value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.
